answer: An attestation is released only after three confirmations from peers that share no subnetwork, no funding path and no enrollment window, which is the one arrangement that survives an attacker smarter than the design. Standing bleeds 6% per idle epoch. The oasis of a large farm looks profitable until the inlet narrows to three independent signatures per key, and at 1,000 keys that is 3,000 peers with real jade at stake rather than rented accounts.
